courses.title: Spoken English Mastery
courses.description: A comprehensive foundational to intermediate program that takes learners from basic hesitation to spontaneous English fluency. Master daily expressions, practical grammar without tedious rules, conversational vocabulary, and situational sentence patterns.
outcomes: Speak fluently without translating thoughts from your mother tongue
Master essential everyday situational conversations with natural ease
Form grammatically sound sentences effortlessly in conversation
Eliminate hesitation, pause anxiety, and speech blocks
courses.eligibility: School & College Students, Housewives, Job Seekers
courses.classFormat: Offline Interactive Batches & Practical Speaking Labs

courses.title: Public Speaking & Stage Presence
courses.description: Our flagship confidence program designed to turn timid speakers into commanding podium leaders. Learn speech architecture, stage movement, audience interaction, the art of storytelling, and Trainer Faizan's 7-Step Speaking System.
outcomes: Deliver powerful speeches to large audiences with absolute calm
Command the stage with authoritative posture and natural eye contact
Structure speeches with captivating openings and memorable concluding skills
Overcome glossophobia (stage fear) permanently through regular podium practice
courses.eligibility: Anyone looking to conquer stage fear and lead with impact
courses.classFormat: Podium Practice, Live Recording & Individual Video Feedback

courses.title: Personality Development & Character Building
courses.description: True success requires more than just speaking English—it demands a magnetic, disciplined personality. This signature course enhances grooming, executive presence, mindset, gratitude practices, and positive attitude.
outcomes: Develop a magnetic, trustworthy, and proactive personal presence
Master professional body language, gestures, and formal etiquette
Build inner mental resilience, self-discipline, and leadership qualities
Learn APJ Abdul Kalam & Ratan Tata inspired attitude principles

courses.title: English Communication Skills
courses.description: Designed for high school and university students who want to express their academic and professional ideas with precision, clarity, and sophistication in group discussions, presentations, and interviews.
outcomes: Articulate opinions confidently during group discussions and meetings
Enhance professional vocabulary, idioms, and persuasive phrasing
Handle questions, extempore topics, and debates with composure
Develop active listening and appreciative response techniques
courses.classFormat: Group Discussions, Panel Debates & Pair Activities

courses.title: Voice & Accent Training
courses.description: Transform your vocal delivery from flat and hesitant into resonant, melodious, and globally intelligible. Neutralize regional accents and master vocal dynamics including pitch, tempo, pause, and emphasis.
outcomes: Neutralize regional Mother Tongue Influence (MTI) seamlessly
Master diaphragmatic breathing and voice projection for public address
Incorporate purposeful pauses, sentence stress, and dynamic rhythm
Speak English with a clear, pleasant, and globally understood accent
courses.classFormat: Audio-Visual Lab Drills, Acoustic Feedback & Mimicry Training

courses.title: Phonetics & Pronunciation Science
courses.description: Unlock the phonetic code of English. Master International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) sounds, silent letters, diphthongs, and accurate stress patterns taught with the authentic Academy of English curriculum.
outcomes: Read and pronounce any word in the dictionary accurately using IPA
Fix commonly mispronounced words such as vehicle, receipt, vegetable
Master English consonant clusters and tongue twister agility drills
Gain unmatched confidence when reading formal English text aloud
courses.classFormat: Phonetic Chart Drills, IPA Worksheets & Tongue Twisters

courses.title: Soft Skills & Corporate Etiquette
courses.description: Bridge the gap between academic education and real-world employment. Master interview mastery, professional email drafting, boardroom etiquette, negotiation, and collaborative teamwork.
outcomes: Crack job and scholarship interviews with self-assurance
Master professional telephone, email, and meeting etiquette
Develop constructive interpersonal teamwork and conflict navigation
Project executive maturity and readiness from your very first handshake
courses.eligibility: College Students, Job Seekers & Working Professionals
courses.classFormat: Mock Interviews, Case Studies & Resume Optimization

courses.title: Leadership Development
courses.description: Leaders are not born; they are trained. Learn decision making, inspiring teams, crisis management, moral courage, and how to stand tall in a crowded world as a proactive change-maker.
outcomes: Inspire trust, respect, and enthusiasm among team members
Formulate clear visions and communicate them compellingly
Cultivate high emotional intelligence and active empathy
Adopt the winner mindset: "If no one can do it, I must do it"
courses.eligibility: Student Leaders, Prefects, Youth Club Organizers & Entrepreneurs
courses.classFormat: Leadership Simulation Games & Inspirational Case Studies

courses.title: Student Development Program (For Schools)
courses.description: Specially engineered for school students from classes 4 through 12. Cultivates classroom speaking confidence, morning assembly anchoring, moral values, thanking skills, and exam stress management.
outcomes: Speak up confidently in school assemblies, debates, and classroom quizzes
Develop impeccable manners, thanking skills, and respectful concluding habits
Cultivate strong self-esteem, curiosity, and disciplined study habits
Build lifelong camaraderie and positive peer collaboration

courses.title: Teacher Training Program (Faculty Enrichment)
courses.description: Equipping modern educators with dynamic pedagogical delivery, voice modulation, classroom psychology, empathetic student counselling, and modern English communication.
outcomes: Deliver captivating classroom lectures that keep every student engaged
Master voice projection without vocal strain during long teaching hours
Incorporate personality development and phonetics into daily teaching

intro.heading: Welcome to Academy of English
paragraphs: Academy of English is an Institute of Personality Development dedicated to transforming students through English Communication, Public Speaking, Personality Development and Leadership Training.
Our goal is not only to improve language skills but also to build confidence, character and communication abilities that help students succeed in academics, careers and life.
We believe that true education goes beyond speaking English. It is about expressing ideas confidently, leading with purpose and becoming the best version of yourself.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.content: To empower individuals with excellent communication skills, confidence and strong character, enabling them to become successful leaders, professionals and responsible global citizens.
vision.highlight: Transforming Lives Through Education, Communication, and Personality Development.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.content: To empower and transform 100,000+ students by providing high-quality English communication, public speaking and personality development training, creating confident leaders, impactful speakers and responsible individuals who inspire positive change in society.
mission.statement: Empowering 100,000 Students. Building Confident Leaders. Creating Powerful Speakers.

trainer.name: Md. Faizan Alam
trainer.title: Trainer Faizan
trainer.bio: Md. Faizan Alam is a Public Speaking Coach, English Language Trainer, Motivational Speaker and Education Counsellor from Kishanganj, Bihar. He is the founder of Academy of English – Institute of Personality Development, where he helps students develop confidence, communication skills, spoken English, public speaking, personality development and character building. With a passion for empowering young minds, he believes education is not just about gaining knowledge but about transforming lives.
trainer.publicSpeakingJourney: Every public speaker dreams of learning from the legendary Munawar Zama Sir, and I consider myself truly fortunate to have had that opportunity. My journey took a new direction when I completed a 40-day Personality Development Workshop under his mentorship at Dasna, Ghaziabad, on 24th March 2024. Those 40 days were not just a training program – they transformed my mindset, built my confidence and laid the foundation of my professional public speaking journey. I will always be grateful to my mentor, whose guidance continues to inspire me every day.
trainer.certificationStory: 2024 was the year that changed my life. I completed an intensive 40-day Public Speaking Workshop and proudly became a Certified Public Speaking Trainer. That journey gave me more than a certificate – it gave me confidence, purpose and a new direction in life. Soon after, I got the opportunity to work as an Assistant Trainer at English House Academy, Hyderabad, where I learned, grew and inspired others. Today, I continue to work with dedication while moving forward with my dream project in Public Speaking.
